title: RNA-seq of human monocyte-derived macrophages in response to Salmonella infection and Chlorpromazine treatment
description: RNA-seq was performed to determine the transcriptional response of human monocyte-derived macrophages to Salmonella infection and whether Chlorpromazine affected this response. These data were used to determine whether enhanced killing capacity of Chlorpromazine treated cells was due to transcriptional control.

samples.title: macrophage.cpz.R1
samples.description: Protocols: Bone marrow flushed from mouse femurs and tibias was washed and plated in RPMI media containing 10% FCS (Sigma). Macrophages were obtained after 7 days of differentiation in the presence of 100 ng/ml M-CSF (R&D). Four million MDM were seeded per condition (Control MDM n=4; CPZ (4 µg/ml) treated n=4; MDM infected with Salmonella (NCTC 12023) n=4 and MDM infected with Salmonella and CPZ treated (4 µg/ml) n=4. Salmonella infection was carried out at MOI 10 for an hour. CPZ treatment was done after Salmonella infection for 4 hours. RNA isolation from MDM was performed using an RNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen) Material was quantified using RiboGreen (Invitrogen) on the FLUOstar OPTIMA plate reader (BMG Labtech) and the size profile and integrity analysed on the 2200 or 4200 TapeStation (Agilent, RNA ScreenTape). Input material was normalised to 1ug prior to library preparation. mRNA was isolated using the NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module (E7490L). Library preparation was completed using TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep Kit High Throughput (Illumina PN:RS-122-2103) following manufacturer’s instructions. Libraries were amplified using in-house unique dual indexing primers (based on DOI: 10.1186/1472-6750-13-104). Individual libraries were normalised using Qubit, and the size profile was analysed on the 2200 or 4200 TapeStation. Individual libraries were normalised and pooled together accordingly. The pooled library was diluted to ~10 nM for storage. The 10 nM library was denatured and further diluted prior to loading on the sequencer.

Input material was normalised to 1ug prior to library preparation. mRNA was isolated using the NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module (E7490L). Library preparation was completed using TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep Kit High Throughput (Illumina PN:RS-122-2103) following manufacturer’s instructions. Libraries were amplified using in-house unique dual indexing primers (based on DOI: 10.1186/1472-6750-13-104). Individual libraries were normalised using Qubit, and the size profile was analysed on the 2200 or 4200 TapeStation. Individual libraries were normalised and pooled together accordingly. The pooled library was diluted to ~10 nM for storage. The 10 nM library was denatured and further diluted prior to loading on the sequencer.
